faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most common questions

items.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
items.answer: SEO results typically start showing within 3-6 months. However, this may vary depending on competition level, industry, and current site status. Technical improvements are completed within the first 30 days, and organic traffic increases are observed within 90 days.

items.question: How does AI-powered ad management work?
items.answer: Our AI algorithms analyze your ad campaigns in real-time. Audience segmentation, budget allocation, and ad copy are automatically optimized. Performance continuously improves through machine learning.

items.question: Is a website in 48 hours really possible?
items.answer: Yes! Thanks to our ready-made templates and optimized workflow, we deliver your corporate website within 48 hours. Custom design projects are scoped based on the project requirements.

items.question: What's the minimum budget?
items.answer: We have packages for every budget. Starting from 5,000 TL/month for SEO and 3,000 TL/month + ad budget for ad management. Let us determine the best package for you with a free analysis.

items.question: Which platforms do you manage ads on?
items.answer: We manage ads on all major platforms including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, and Bing. We also offer ad optimization on marketplaces like Trendyol and Hepsiburada.

items.question: How is reporting done?
items.answer: You can track your campaign performance 24/7 through a real-time dashboard. Weekly and monthly detailed reports are also shared via email. Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and platform-specific metrics are included in reports.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Megis, we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it when you visit our website.

sections.title: Data Collected
sections.content: When you visit our website, technical data such as browser type, IP address, pages visited, and visit duration may be automatically collected. Through the contact form, you may share personal information such as name, email address, and message content.

sections.title: Purpose of Data Use
sections.content: Collected data is used to improve service quality, analyze website performance, respond to your communication requests, and fulfill our legal obligations.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: Our website uses essential, analytics, marketing, and functional cookies. You can manage your cookie preferences through the cookie banner at the bottom of our website.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: Your personal data is protected with industry-standard security measures. SSL encryption, firewalls, and access controls are implemented.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: Under applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, delete, and object to the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at info@megis.com.tr.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions about our privacy policy, you can email us at info@megis.com.tr.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using this website, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: General Terms
sections.content: This website is operated by Megis. The content on the website is for informational purposes and may be changed without prior notice.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content, designs, logos, and software on the website are the intellectual property of Megis. Unauthorized copying, distribution, or modification is prohibited.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: While Megis takes the utmost care regarding the accuracy of information on the website, it does not guarantee the completeness or timeliness of such information.

sections.title: External Links
sections.content: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. Megis is not responsible for the content of these sites.

sections.title: Applicable Law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. Turkish courts have jurisdiction over disputes.

kvkk.title: Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.intro: In accordance with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), your personal data is processed by Megis as the data controller as described below.

sections.title: Data Controller
sections.content: Your personal data is processed by Megis as the data controller.

sections.title: Personal Data Processed
sections.content: Identity information (name, surname), contact information (email, phone), transaction security information (IP address, cookie data), and marketing information (preferences, interests) may be processed.

sections.title: Processing Purposes
sections.content: Your personal data is processed for service delivery, communication management, website security and performance analysis, fulfillment of legal obligations, and marketing activities.

sections.title: Data Transfer
sections.content: Your personal data may be shared with our service providers (hosting, analytics, email services) and authorized institutions within the scope of legal obligations.

sections.title: Data Retention Period
sections.content: Your personal data is retained for the duration required by the processing purpose and within legal retention periods.

sections.title: Your Rights (KVKK Art.11)
sections.content: You have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information if processed, to learn the purpose of processing, to learn whether data is transferred to third parties, to request correction if incomplete or incorrect, to request deletion or destruction, to request notification of corrections to third parties, to object to automated analysis results, and to claim compensation for damages from unlawful processing.

sections.title: Application
sections.content: To exercise your rights, you can email info@megis.com.tr or use the contact form.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Megis (megis.com.tr) uses cookies and similar technologies. By using the site, you accept this policy.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites recognise you and remember your preferences. Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser; persistent cookies remain for a set period.

sections.title: Cookies We Use
sections.content: Essential Cookies: Required for core functionality such as session management and security. Analytics Cookies: Visitor counts and usage statistics (Google Analytics 4, Yandex.Metrika). Marketing Cookies: Used for targeted advertising and campaign measurement. Functional Cookies: Used to remember your language and theme preferences.

sections.title: Google Consent Mode v2
sections.content: We implement Google Consent Mode v2. Even if you decline analytics or marketing cookies, Google services may operate in modelling mode for basic functionality without personalisation.

sections.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
sections.content: You can set your preferences via the cookie banner on your first visit. You may decline all non-essential cookies and update your preferences at any time. You can also manage cookies through your browser settings, though some features may not work correctly.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For questions about our cookie policy, please email info@megis.com.tr.

dsar.title: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR)
dsar.intro: You may exercise your personal data rights under KVKK Article 11 and GDPR Articles 15–22 by following the instructions below.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access your personal data, request correction of inaccurate data, request erasure under certain conditions, request restriction of processing, request data portability, and object to processing.

sections.title: How to Submit a Request
sections.content: Send an email to info@megis.com.tr with the subject line 'DSAR Request'. Please include your full name, contact details, the service you used, and the type of request.

sections.title: Response Time
sections.content: Requests will be answered within 30 days under KVKK and within 1 month (extendable to 3 months) under GDPR. Identity verification may be required.

sections.title: Right to Lodge a Complaint
sections.content: If you are not satisfied with our response, you may lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Authority (kvkk.gov.tr) for KVKK, or with your national data protection authority for GDPR.
